scope: S1-008 sample PCA and sample correlation only, all original21 samples. No DE comparison, old QC/Median/GroupStats/preprocessing rerun, imputation, new normalization, sample removal or HTTP/DB/worker publication.

entrypoints.default: Inert on source; functions and typed internal inputs are not Owner authorization.

input_binding.parent: Complete existing LFQ positive-log2/None/no-imputation metadata, not standalone Median. Original project/dataset/file/source/config/report/flags/family/manifest and all11 artifact pins retained.
input_binding.bytes: All11 original artifact SHA256 and exact lengths checked before/after. Original canonical name order is fixed, never locale-sorted. Full working matrix and four masks decoded without row/sample changes; mask identities/NA union and no-imputation state verified.
input_binding.design: Saved confirmed4cf design for same project/original dataset/family. Every original sample name and source ordinal in original order; no WT/100/name inference. Full saved rows, conditions, groups and replicate metadata retained.
input_binding.provenance_boundary: A trusted future coordinator first validates complete metadata/schema/Owner/storage. Actual finite target reuses the previously validated full QC audit inputs and verifies fresh exact-version read-only DB digests before/after. This is operator evidence, not OwnerHTTP/RLS or publication.

PCA.observations: All original samples, none automatically excluded.
PCA.variables: All original protein-group rows with finite values in EVERY sample, followed by removal of zero-SD rows across samples. No filling; original dataset remains untouched.
PCA.row_audit: Every original record_number and exact protein_ids_raw, including duplicates, with finite/missing n, complete-case, native stats::sd, row eligibility, actual PCA inclusion and explicit missing/constant/nonfinite/global-not-estimable reason.
PCA.minimum: At least3 samples and2 eligible variable proteins; otherwise specific PCA status and no fabricated PCA SVG. Native numerical failure is reported, without solver fallback or silent extra row filtering.
PCA.centering: Protein-variable centering across samples only inside PCA. No variance standardization, global normalization or modification of saved quantification.
PCA.exports: Complete native scores, rotation/loadings, all sdev and variance/explained/cumulative fractions, centers and full selected original source rows, including original record/sample identities. Near-zero native components are retained.
PCA.plot: PC1/PC2 diagnostic only, standard ggplot2 points/text. No unreliable n3 confidence ellipse, sample outlier exclusion or automatic statistical decision.
PCA.sign: PC signs and tied-component rotations are arbitrary; hand target verifies variance proportions and distance/Gram invariants, not fixed loading/score signs.

correlation.rows: All original retained protein rows, NOT PCA-selected rows or differential proteins.
correlation.paired_n: Complete original sample x sample observed finite counts from base crossprod; every ordered pair exported with n and paired sample SDs.
correlation.NA_policy: n<3, zero paired sample SD, nonfinite paired SD or nonfinite native correlation yields NA and explicit reason. No NA->0 or NA->1, including insufficient/constant diagonal. Native estimable diagonal1 is retained.
correlation.constant_warning: Only the expected native standard-deviation-is-zero warning is consumed; constant conditions remain explicit. Other warnings refuse.
correlation.entirely_unestimable: If no off-diagonal pair is estimable, status no_estimable_sample_pairs and no invented correlation SVG; full n/reason/matrix data remain exported.
correlation.heatmap: pheatmap1.0.13 standard gtable on original grDevices::svg. Fixed breaks[-1,1], NA grey#BDBDBD, scale none, cluster_rows FALSE, cluster_cols FALSE, original saved21-sample order.

labels_and_rendering.identity: ASCII S01.. and G01.. aliases map one-to-one to exact original sample/group names and source ordinals in sample-map.tsv and full design. No raw identity discarded or guessed.
labels_and_rendering.labels: Standard ggplot2::geom_text; every sample key retained, no ggrepel dependency, randomness or seed. Package-native Dark3 group palette shared by PCA and heatmap.
labels_and_rendering.format: SVG only,13x10 inches, grDevices::svg family sans; standard package draw, no custom algorithm/JS charts, PNG or PDF.
labels_and_rendering.font_policy: ASCII plotted aliases avoid Chinese font requirements while raw Chinese design names remain in data/provenance. No font installation/global font-file/config edits; private audit TMPDIR/XDG_CACHE_HOME. SVG opens before pheatmap sizing/rendering.

outputs.serialization: Complete UTF8 LF quoted TSV at numeric %.17g. Full original token matrix and selected rows exported, no preview truncation. Full provenance includes complete parent/design, parameters and native statistical objects. Original four mask bytes remain unchanged in the reused full input bundle, all11 byte-pinned.
outputs.readiness: Independent PCA/correlation statuses; global analysis_ready FALSE. A successful standalone statistical diagram is not a controlled job or published version.

resources: 1..10000 original rows,1..64 samples and<=2M cells. At most64x64 pair rows. Original source artifacts retain their admitted sizes; each output<=32MiB and aggregate<=128MiB. No truncation. Process admission belongs to future reviewed runner; actual standalone leaf had60s native timeout.

Missing/constant row reasons exact. Pearson5/sqrt28 and1, paired n3, constant and n2 diagonals/pairs remain NA with reason. Insufficient samples/eligible rows and entirely missing correlation explicitly not estimable.
